haydnburrell_9thky: Dietrich Thky told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
Dietrich Thky opened a parcel addressed in an unfamiliar hand. Inside was a note explaining that the usual letter writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
henri.hakkinen.566: The draft reached S-F17 on Day 3. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
